— the foreign business belongs to the same taxpayer,
— the taxpayer is a co-entrepreneur of the foreign business,
— the taxpayer holds a substantial interest, i.e. more than 25%, in the foreign corporation, or
— the same persons exercise management or control over both businesses or have influence on them.
